title: Smoking Pi – Overview
description: The landing page: where the Pi is connected (uplink, Wi-Fi, public address, network, approximate place, resolver), what it is measuring, and links to the detailed dashboards.

links.title: Target detail
links.tooltip: Every layer measured for this target (ICMP, TCP, HTTP by version, DNS) on one page

panels.title: Uplink
panels.description: The interface every measurement leaves through (wifi_link.py, host_uplink).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and (r._field == "interface" or r._field == "kind")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.interface == "" then "no route" else r.interface + " (" + r.kind + ")"})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Wi-Fi network (SSID)
panels.description: The network the Pi is associated to. Empty on a wired Pi.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "wifi_link" and r._field == "associated") |> group() |> last() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.ssid})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Public address (IPv4)
panels.description: The address the Internet sees, from Google's authoritative DNS (public_ip.py).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.ip})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Network (ISP)
panels.description: The network (AS) announcing the public address, from Team Cymru.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.owner != "") |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: "AS" + string(v: r.asn) + " " + r.owner})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Approximate location
panels.description: Geolocation BY ADDRESS, from ipinfo.io: often the ISP's point of presence, never the house. Off with PUBLIC_IP_GEO=0.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv4" and (r._field == "ip" or r._field == "asn" or r._field == "owner" or r._field == "city" or r._field == "region" or r._field == "country")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.country != "") |> map(fn:(r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.city + ", " + r.region + ", " + r.country})) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: DNS answered by
panels.description: Who resolves for the house through the router (resolver_identity.py; docs/public-resolver.md).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and r.path == "router" and r._field == "owner") |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Public IPv6
panels.description: Absent when the house has no IPv6 route.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-2h) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "public_ip" and r.family == "ipv6" and r._field == "ip") |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns:["_time","_value"])

panels.title: Targets answering, by layer
panels.description: Targets with a measurement in the last 15 minutes, per layer. The welcome tour and the Targets page say what each layer tells you.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"ICMP ping"})

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "dns_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"DNS resolution"})

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "tcp_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"TCP handshake"})

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "http_latency" and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> distinct(column:"target") |> count() |> rename(columns:{_value:"HTTP/1.1–3"})

panels.title: Targets losing packets
panels.description: Targets whose last measurement lost at least one probe, all layers. The DNS wizard's targets are left out, as in alerting: many CDNs drop ICMP (see the next panel).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target","category"]) |> last() |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.category != "dns_wizard" and r._value > 0.0) |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: DNS wizard targets not answering
panels.description: Adopted from the DNS wizard, losing probes now. Usually a CDN that drops ICMP rather than an outage: pause them from the Targets page, or measure the service over HTTP or TCP instead.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-15m) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group(columns:["_measurement","target","category"]) |> last() |> group() |> filter(fn:(r) => r.category == "dns_wizard" and r._value > 0.0) |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])

panels.title: Measurements in the last hour
panels.description: Measurement rounds written in the last hour, all layers (each is several probes).

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:-1h) |> filter(fn:(r) => (r._measurement == "latency" or r._measurement == "dns_latency" or r._measurement == "tcp_latency" or r._measurement == "http_latency") and r._field == "loss") |> group() |> count() |> keep(columns:["_value"])
